title: Chromatographic determination of 12 dyes in meat products by HPLC-UV-DIODE array detection
author: Iammarino, Mentana, et al.

steps.title: Prepare extraction solvent mixture
steps.instruction: Mix acetonitrile, methanol, water and ammonia in a volumetric ratio of 50:40:9:1 (v/v/v/v) to obtain the extraction solvent.

steps.title: Extract dyes from homogenized meat
steps.instruction: Weigh 2 g of homogenized fresh meat or meat product into a 50 mL polypropylene tube, add 20 mL of the prepared solvent, vortex‑shake for 2 min at 2500 rpm, transfer the tube contents to a 100 mL flask and place it in an ultrasonic bath for 90 min (frequency = 100 Hz, temperature = 40 °C ± 4 °C). Return the extract to a 50 mL polypropylene tube and vortex‑shake again for 1 min at 2500 rpm.

steps.title: Filter extract for HPLC injection
steps.instruction: Collect approximately 1.5 mL of the final extract, pass it through a 0.2 µm Minisart® NML surfactant‑free cellulose acetate syringe filter, and keep the filtrate for injection.

steps.title: Prepare HPLC mobile phases
steps.instruction: Prepare mobile phase A: 0.02 M acetate buffer adjusted to pH 7.0; prepare mobile phase B: HPLC‑grade acetonitrile.

steps.title: Program HPLC gradient and run
steps.instruction: Set the HPLC system to a flow rate of 1.2 mL min⁻¹, injection volume 10 µL, detection at 520 nm (DAD range 250–600 nm). Use the following gradient (total run 52 min): 0 % B → 15 % B in 15 min; 15 % B → 34 % B in the next 10 min; 34 % B → 80 % B in 1 min; hold isocratic at 80 % B for 21 min; return to 0 % B in 1 min; re‑equilibrate for 4 min.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards
Calculate LOD and LOQ
steps.instruction: From each calibration curve obtain the slope (b) and the standard deviation of the intercept (sₐ); compute LOD = 3.3 sₐ / b and LOQ = 10 sₐ / b.

steps.title: Assess method selectivity
steps.instruction: Analyze 20 blank samples of fresh meat and meat products under the HPLC method and verify that no peaks appear within ±2.5 % of each dye’s retention time.

steps.title: Evaluate accuracy (recovery)
steps.instruction: Prepare three sets of blank pork fresh‑meat samples (six replicates per set). Fortify each replicate with each dye at three concentration levels: 25, 50 and 100 mg kg⁻¹. Extract, filter and analyse as described above; calculate precision (CV %) and trueness (recovery %).

steps.title: Test method ruggedness
steps.instruction: Perform twelve independent experiments using four replicates each of cow fresh meat, salami and seasoned sausage. Fortify all matrices with 25 mg kg⁻¹ of each dye, except Carmine (100 mg kg⁻¹) and Sudan IV (50 mg kg⁻¹). Process and analyse as per the extraction and HPLC steps, then compare results with those obtained for the validation matrix (pork fresh meat) using the Youden‑Steiner standard‑deviation‑of‑difference test (2‑tail F test, 7 and 11 df, 95 % confidence).

steps.title: Determine measurement uncertainty
steps.instruction: Apply the bottom‑up approach, propagating the uncertainties estimated for each step of the analytical procedure to obtain the expanded measurement uncertainty (k = 2).
